title: Object authorization
prerequisites: Two owned accounts and private fixtures with known IDs.
invariant: Only the owner or explicit grantee accesses an object.
test: Compare one owner request with the same request under the second owned account.
oracle: The second account receives the first account's private canary or changes its fixture.
false_positive: Public objects, valid shares, cached owner responses.
stop: Stop after one controlled boundary crossing; never enumerate IDs.

title: Tenant and organization isolation
prerequisites: Two controlled organizations; document intended membership.
invariant: Every query, mutation, search and derived artifact retains tenant context.
test: Compare one known private fixture across owned tenants including one alternate interface.
oracle: Other-tenant canary or authoritative state change.
false_positive: Users belonging to both tenants or intentional organization-wide sharing.
stop: Stop on real-tenant material or unknown ownership.

title: Role and function authorization
prerequisites: Two owned roles and one reversible restricted operation.
invariant: Privileges are enforced by the server for every operation.
test: Replay the observed operation using the lower role against an owned fixture.
oracle: The restricted synthetic operation persists and audit identity matches the lower role.
false_positive: Visible buttons or HTTP 200 without authorized effect.
stop: Do not grant production administrator access or change other users.

title: Property authorization and mass assignment
prerequisites: A schema or captured request plus a controlled protected field.
invariant: Readable and writable properties depend on caller policy.
test: Compare serialization and one reversible protected-field update on a synthetic record.
oracle: Restricted field disclosure or persisted unauthorized value.
false_positive: Reflection, ignored fields, legitimate writable fields.
stop: Stop before sensitive privilege or billing state changes.

title: Authentication, MFA and alternate channels
prerequisites: Owned login identities and supported web/API recovery channels.
invariant: All routes to the protected session satisfy required factors.
test: Compare a completed login with an incomplete-factor state through an observed alternate route.
oracle: Protected own-account data becomes available without the required factor.
false_positive: Public page, cached content, remembered-device policy.
stop: No credential guessing, account lockouts or anti-abuse evasion.

title: Recovery, verification and account linking
prerequisites: Owned inboxes and test accounts; documented lifecycle.
invariant: A recovery or linking capability binds to its owner, purpose and current state.
test: Use controlled tokens across their intended issue, consume, expire and invalidate transitions.
oracle: A mismatched or invalidated token performs a protected synthetic transition.
false_positive: Token reuse allowed by policy or unrelated logged-in session.
stop: No links sent to real people; stop before locking out testers.

title: Session, refresh and revocation
prerequisites: Separate owned browser profiles and session aliases.
invariant: Logout, privilege change and revocation have documented session effects.
test: Compare own protected reads before and after a controlled revocation.
oracle: Old credential still accesses the canary beyond the documented validity boundary.
false_positive: Browser cache, one-session logout semantics, permitted grace window.
stop: Do not collect session tokens from real users.

title: OAuth and OIDC binding
prerequisites: Owned client, accounts and authorized test identity provider.
invariant: Issuer, client, redirect, state and login transaction remain correctly bound.
test: Compare a valid controlled flow with one changed binding in the test environment.
oracle: Wrong controlled account/client is accepted or protected action occurs.
false_positive: Intentional account switch or state lost by test tooling.
stop: No testing of third-party providers without separate scope.

title: SAML signed-to-consumed identity
prerequisites: Test identity provider, signed fixtures and verifier/parser access.
invariant: The consumed identity and audience equal what was verified.
test: Compare verified and consumed normalized trees in a local signed-fixture harness.
oracle: Different identity, audience or validity selected after signature verification.
false_positive: Debug representation differs while selected security fields agree.
stop: Use local fixtures; no real identity impersonation.

title: JWT and capability token validation
prerequisites: Owned token issuer or isolated test service with controlled keys.
invariant: Issuer, audience, algorithm, signature, purpose and lifetime are enforced.
test: Run valid and intentionally invalid claim/signature fixtures against the local verifier.
oracle: Invalid fixture authorizes a protected synthetic operation.
false_positive: Decode success alone or an endpoint that ignores the token.
stop: No key guessing or use of captured third-party tokens.

title: CSRF and action intent
prerequisites: Owned browser session and reversible action.
invariant: A cross-site caller cannot cause protected action without required intent proof.
test: Attempt the action from an owned distinct origin with a valid same-origin control.
oracle: Authoritative synthetic state changes in the actual browser.
false_positive: Direct replay succeeding despite browser blocking or benign action.
stop: No real-user involvement or irreversible action.

title: CORS and cross-origin data access
prerequisites: Owned distinct origins and a private synthetic response.
invariant: Untrusted origins cannot read protected authenticated data.
test: Compare allowed and untrusted origins using an actual browser.
oracle: Untrusted origin reads the protected canary.
false_positive: Permissive headers rejected by browser or public information.
stop: Stop at the synthetic canary; do not collect secrets.

title: Reflected, stored and DOM script injection
prerequisites: Known rendering context and isolated owned viewer.
invariant: Untrusted text remains data at its final browser sink.
test: Trace source to sink and use a harmless local marker in an isolated viewer.
oracle: Unexpected script execution in the relevant origin and intended viewer context.
false_positive: Plain reflection, self-only behavior, inactive markup.
stop: No credential access, network collection or real viewers.

title: Browser messaging, DOM navigation and storage trust
prerequisites: Observed postMessage or URL/storage-to-sink path.
invariant: Origin, sender, destination and schema are validated before sensitive action.
test: Send one harmless controlled message or navigation input from a second owned origin.
oracle: Unauthorized canary read or reversible action with source and sink evidence.
false_positive: Message received but discarded, intentional public navigation.
stop: Stop before actual token forwarding or external navigation.

title: Framing and UI action integrity
prerequisites: Owned browser, framable page and reversible sensitive action.
invariant: Untrusted framing cannot cause a protected action under misleading UI.
test: Use a local frame fixture and manually verify a harmless owned action.
oracle: Protected state changes through the misleading controlled frame.
false_positive: Framable public page with no sensitive effect.
stop: Never involve unsuspecting users.

title: SQL and structured query injection
prerequisites: Reachable query input and controlled dataset or local query trace.
invariant: User values cannot change the intended query structure.
test: Compare paired bounded inputs against known fixture rows or inspect the parsed query locally.
oracle: Unauthorized synthetic row or changed query structure attributable to input.
false_positive: Generic errors, unstable counts or intentionally expressive filters.
stop: No extraction of real rows or delay/resource amplification.

title: NoSQL, ORM and hidden-property inference
prerequisites: Observed structured filters and owned known private attributes.
invariant: Filtering and relation traversal enforce property and tenant permissions.
test: Compare two known private attribute conditions on owned fixtures.
oracle: Private attribute changes result membership or unauthorized relation traversal occurs.
false_positive: Documented searchable property or unrelated sort instability.
stop: No iterative inference of real secrets.

title: Template and expression evaluation
prerequisites: A server-rendered template/expression sink and local or isolated fixture.
invariant: User text cannot become executable template logic.
test: Trace render construction and use a harmless deterministic expression in the fixture.
oracle: Server evaluates expression where only literal text was permitted.
false_positive: Client-side evaluation or intended safe templating feature.
stop: No file access, command execution or environment disclosure.

title: Command, code and argument boundary
prerequisites: Source path to a process/evaluator and an isolated harness.
invariant: Untrusted values remain structured data, never executable syntax or options.
test: Inspect argument construction and substitute a benign controlled marker in a local stub.
oracle: Stub receives an unintended argument/operation or evaluator crosses its boundary.
false_positive: Dangerous API with no reachable controllable input.
stop: No shells, production command execution or outbound callbacks.

title: Deserialization and object reconstruction
prerequisites: A reachable object decoder and isolated fixture.
invariant: Untrusted bytes cannot select unauthorized object types or side effects.
test: Trace decoder allowlists and instrument benign local constructors.
oracle: Untrusted fixture reaches an unexpected constructor or protected state mutation.
false_positive: Parsing succeeds without security-relevant behavior.
stop: No gadget chains or production object execution.

title: XML and external resource resolution
prerequisites: XML consumer or file converter plus controlled resolver.
invariant: Parsing cannot load unauthorized external resources.
test: Instrument a local resolver with a bounded benign resource and compare disabled resolution.
oracle: Resolver invoked contrary to policy, with exact parser path.
false_positive: Normal application fetching or inaccessible configuration-only suspicion.
stop: No filesystem secrets, metadata services or expansion bombs.

title: SSRF and destination validation
prerequisites: Observed server fetcher and approved controlled receiver.
invariant: Every resolved destination and redirect stays within the fetch policy.
test: Compare permitted and prohibited controlled destinations in an isolated harness.
oracle: Server reaches the prohibited controlled receiver; browser traffic excluded.
false_positive: Link preview from the tester, expected proxy, allowed external fetch.
stop: No internal scanning, cloud metadata access or unbounded redirects.

title: Filesystem paths, archives and links
prerequisites: Owned file fixture and isolated filesystem root.
invariant: Resolved paths remain inside the authorized root after normalization and extraction.
test: Inspect canonical path checks using local boundary, symlink and archive fixtures.
oracle: Synthetic file escapes its assigned root or another controlled fixture is read.
false_positive: Filename echo without actual file access.
stop: No sensitive files or writes outside the isolated test area.

title: Uploads, converters and content boundaries
prerequisites: Documented upload policy and isolated preview/conversion path.
invariant: Accepted content remains inert and isolated through every downstream consumer.
test: Submit a benign format mismatch fixture and inspect storage, headers and converter behavior.
oracle: Unexpected active interpretation or controlled cross-boundary read/write.
false_positive: Rejected files, client MIME labels, inert stored data.
stop: No active malware, production execution or large decompression.

title: Prototype and shared-object mutation
prerequisites: JavaScript merge/path setter and isolated execution context.
invariant: User properties cannot alter shared prototypes or security defaults.
test: Instrument a harmless marker in a local merge fixture and compare a fresh object.
oracle: Unrelated fresh object inherits unauthorized marker; relevant sink separately established.
false_positive: Own property only or no reachable downstream effect.
stop: Reset local process; no shared production state mutation.

title: HTTP parser, routing and normalization disagreements
prerequisites: Known edge/backend topology and dedicated replica.
invariant: Intermediaries and origin agree on request boundaries and authorization route.
test: Compare component parse traces with controlled local requests.
oracle: Same bytes select different route/message boundaries relevant to enforcement.
false_positive: Timeout alone or independent requests on different connections.
stop: Dedicated infrastructure only for desynchronization tests.

title: Cache isolation and response confusion
prerequisites: Dedicated test cache/key space and two owned identities.
invariant: Private responses and attacker-controlled variants cannot contaminate another security context.
test: Compare own synthetic responses under controlled key/normalization variations.
oracle: Second owned identity receives private or altered canary from the cache.
false_positive: Origin personalization, stale browser cache, public-by-design object.
stop: No poisoning shared live cache; stop when isolation cannot be guaranteed.

title: Workflow order and approval binding
prerequisites: Documented business rule and reversible sandbox workflow.
invariant: Required steps and approvals bind to the exact actor, object and final parameters.
test: Compare normal flow with one omitted/reordered step or changed approved fixture field.
oracle: Authoritative state violates the documented workflow invariant.
false_positive: Alternative legitimate workflow or display-only inconsistency.
stop: No real financial or irreversible state changes.

title: Numeric, accounting and domain invariants
prerequisites: Sandbox order/credit fixture and intended arithmetic rules.
invariant: Amounts, units, precision and limits remain consistent across components.
test: Compare a small boundary-value fixture through calculation, approval and persistence.
oracle: Authoritative synthetic totals or entitlements contradict the invariant.
false_positive: Rounding allowed by policy or UI/server representation difference.
stop: No real charges, redemptions or balance creation.

title: Race and temporary-state enforcement
prerequisites: Isolated resettable fixture, sequential control and explicit concurrency budget.
invariant: Concurrent operations preserve the same ownership/one-use invariant as sequential ones.
test: Compare one bounded local interleaving with the equivalent sequential sequence.
oracle: Final authoritative state shows extra effect or forbidden temporary-state access.
false_positive: Duplicate responses with one committed effect; eventual consistency.
stop: Stop at budget, instability or first proved synthetic effect.

title: Replay, idempotency and stale capabilities
prerequisites: Owned one-use action and resettable fixture.
invariant: Retries cannot repeat protected effects; stale capabilities obey lifecycle rules.
test: Replay one controlled completed request and compare effect count with normal retry policy.
oracle: A second prohibited synthetic effect occurs.
false_positive: Expected idempotent response or allowed repeated action.
stop: No repeated production charges, messages or destructive actions.

title: Alternate API, GraphQL and batch paths
prerequisites: Observed equivalent operations or authorized schema.
invariant: Equivalent operations enforce equivalent object, field and function policies.
test: Compare one controlled object through direct, nested, batch or legacy operation.
oracle: Only alternate path exposes the private canary or performs restricted mutation.
false_positive: Introspection or alternate operation existence alone.
stop: No depth amplification or broad endpoint spraying.

title: WebSocket, SSE and subscription lifecycle
prerequisites: Owned sessions, channels and message fixtures.
invariant: Authorization applies per subscription/message and after revocation.
test: Compare controlled subscription before/after revocation and across two owned channels.
oracle: Other-account canary arrives or revoked action commits.
false_positive: Handshake success with no unauthorized message.
stop: No traffic flooding or real-room subscription.

title: Background jobs, exports and derived artifacts
prerequisites: Owned async job, worker trace or observable lifecycle.
invariant: Tenant and permission context survive enqueue, processing, status and delivery.
test: Compare controlled job/download before and after membership revocation at distinct stages.
oracle: Private canary delivered or job operates under wrong synthetic tenant.
false_positive: Accepted enqueue without completed effect or documented immutable export sharing.
stop: No exports containing real-user data.

title: Webhooks and third-party response trust
prerequisites: Owned receiver, synthetic events and signature verifier.
invariant: Event origin, integrity, ownership, freshness and ordering are validated.
test: Compare valid and invalid signed synthetic events in a local verifier and delivery fixture.
oracle: Invalid or wrong-owner event produces a protected synthetic transition.
false_positive: Delivery accepted but ignored; intentionally idempotent response.
stop: No impersonation of live payment provider or real customer event.

title: Cloud storage, DNS and delegated ownership
prerequisites: Company-owned infrastructure inventory and controlled resources.
invariant: Storage and namespace ownership match intended principals and lifecycle.
test: Inspect policy and compare owned canary access across controlled principals; verify dangling references without claiming them.
oracle: Private canary accessible contrary to policy or demonstrable ownership gap.
false_positive: Public bucket, CDN alias or dangling DNS alone without takeover preconditions.
stop: Do not register namespaces or use found credentials without exact authorization.

title: Secrets, debug, backups and configuration exposure
prerequisites: Observed company artifact, known synthetic secret or owner-assisted classification.
invariant: Private operational data is not returned to unauthorized callers.
test: Check one observed resource or local artifact; redact and classify exposed material.
oracle: Verified private synthetic value or sensitive configuration returned contrary to policy.
false_positive: Public client keys, sample credentials, banners alone.
stop: Do not validate live credentials or download large sensitive archives.

title: Source, dependency and build trust boundaries
prerequisites: Company source at known commit; manifests and build workflow.
invariant: Untrusted contributions/dependencies cannot acquire privileged build/runtime effects.
test: Trace source to sink and inspect build permission boundaries; use local stubs for proof.
oracle: Reachable controllable path crosses an intended privilege boundary.
false_positive: Unreachable function or version match without affected code/configuration.
stop: Do not execute unfamiliar install hooks or publish deceptive packages.

title: Resource limits and costly business flows
prerequisites: Contract-defined tiny budget and code/configuration access.
invariant: One request/action has bounded cost and enforceable per-principal limits.
test: Inspect limits and run a minimal bounded fixture below disruption thresholds.
oracle: Code/config proves missing enforcement with small measured work amplification.
false_positive: Slow response alone, deliberate expensive operation with adequate quotas.
stop: Stop at first latency/load change or quota response; no exhaustion.

title: Cryptographic use, signatures and transport
prerequisites: Known protocol design, controlled keys and local verifier.
invariant: Protected data is confidential/integrity-bound to identity, purpose and context.
test: Inspect library configuration and compare valid/invalid known-answer fixtures.
oracle: Invalid signature/context accepted or sensitive fixture sent outside required channel.
false_positive: Algorithm name alone, certificate warning caused by interception.
stop: No cryptanalysis claims, key brute force or third-party decryption.

title: AI retrieval, tools, memory and approval
prerequisites: Owned tenants, synthetic documents and harmless instrumented tool.
invariant: Untrusted content cannot broaden data access, tools or approved side effects.
test: Compare direct/indirect controlled input across roles; record actual retrieval/tool arguments and policy decisions.
oracle: Cross-tenant canary or prohibited harmless tool effect; text agreement alone excluded.
false_positive: Jailbreak wording, generic system prompt exposure, intended tools.
stop: No real secret extraction, cost loops or external side effects.

title: Mobile, native and specialist boundaries
prerequisites: Owned device/emulator or isolated native harness and specialist context.
invariant: Platform storage, IPC, deep links and native memory enforce their intended boundaries.
test: Route relevant checks to MASTG or a bounded sanitizer harness with synthetic fixtures.
oracle: Controlled unauthorized IPC/data effect or minimized security-relevant sanitizer trace.
false_positive: Root-only access or crash alone labeled remote code execution.
stop: Do not claim comprehensive hardware/kernel/crypto coverage; obtain required environment.
